name: WIREONE Electric - Des Moines

about:
WIREONE Electric operates from Pleasant Hill, Iowa, serving Greater Des Moines and Central Iowa through seven regional offices. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides residential and commercial electrical services including wiring, lighting installation, electrical panel and breaker work, surge protection, outlet and switch installation, smart home technology integration, safety inspections, rewiring, ceiling fan installation, and EV charging station installation. Technicians operate from a mobile warehouse stocked with thousands of parts, enabling most jobs to be completed in a single visit. The team completes over 200 hours of continuing education annually, well above the 18-hour requirement.

Customers include homeowners, businesses, and real estate professionals across Iowa and Illinois communities such as Ankeny, Cedar Rapids, Davenport, and Moline. The company’s blog addresses commercial electrical safety inspections, home buyer and seller inspections, and Midwest weather preparedness.

WIREONE emphasizes 24/7 availability with same-day service, upfront pricing with financing options, and a five-year warranty included on every service at no extra cost. The company was built on a “1 Visit & Done” model, aiming to resolve issues on the first appointment.
